requirements.invariant: Parameter binding preserves positional, named, default, preset, variadic, and diagnostic rules.
requirements.owner_boundary: typechecker partial projection and replacement call runtime
requirements.internal_only_rationale: Binding slots are shared call machinery, not a user feature.

requirements.invariant: Closure and partial capture reads occur at construction time with explicit ownership.
requirements.owner_boundary: Body IR closure lowering and replacement runtime
requirements.internal_only_rationale: Lexical environments are private runtime state.

requirements.invariant: Branches, loops, returns, assertions, and breaks execute from normalized Body IR.
requirements.owner_boundary: Body IR lowering and replacement evaluator
requirements.internal_only_rationale: Normalized control nodes are implementation vocabulary.

requirements.invariant: Scalars, strings, operators, conversions, and scalar JSON stringification preserve checked type, exact bytes, and failure behavior.
requirements.owner_boundary: Body IR operands/rvalues and replacement evaluator
requirements.internal_only_rationale: Scalar representation is an internal evaluator mechanism.

requirements.invariant: Source-local direct tasks preserve construction, polling, source-order race ties, cancellation, and receipt-bound lifecycle evidence.
requirements.owner_boundary: source-local Body IR plus replacement task runtime
requirements.internal_only_rationale: Task frames are private direct-execution machinery, not a general scheduler claim.

requirements.invariant: Every local or nested callable has isolated locals, return flow, and source-owned spans.
requirements.owner_boundary: replacement runtime call dispatcher
requirements.verification_anchor: stored-callable Body-IR tests and #1152 execution probes
requirements.internal_only_rationale: Frames enable several callable features without being user-visible themselves.

requirements.invariant: Refusals and failures retain original source spans and intentional diagnostic categories.
requirements.owner_boundary: frontend diagnostics and backend selection receipts
requirements.internal_only_rationale: Diagnostic routing is a compiler mechanism, not a separate capability.

requirements.invariant: Success/error values, propagation, and handler ordering survive direct execution.
requirements.owner_boundary: Body IR try lowering and replacement runtime
requirements.internal_only_rationale: Error routing serves many source spellings.

requirements.invariant: Iterator acquisition, next polling, exhaustion, and fallible routing use compiler-resolved protocol facts.
requirements.owner_boundary: typechecker protocol facts, Body IR, replacement runtime
requirements.internal_only_rationale: Protocol dispatch is private shared machinery.

requirements.invariant: Imports, aliases, and calls use canonical source identities rather than generated-Rust spellings.
requirements.owner_boundary: module resolver and semantic facts
requirements.internal_only_rationale: Canonical identity is a compiler fact.

requirements.invariant: Nominal instances, fields, discriminators, defaults, and statics have direct runtime representation.
requirements.owner_boundary: Body IR value lowering and replacement runtime
requirements.internal_only_rationale: The value model is internal runtime machinery.

requirements.invariant: Public API, ABI, source maps, library manifests, and provider identity remain versioned semantic contracts.
requirements.owner_boundary: package/ABI boundary
requirements.internal_only_rationale: Package machinery has no one-to-one public capability.

requirements.invariant: Pattern alternatives, destructuring, guards, and exhaustiveness route through explicit value tests.
requirements.owner_boundary: typechecker match facts and Body IR
requirements.internal_only_rationale: Pattern dispatch is shared execution machinery.

requirements.invariant: Stdlib providers expose checked activation, service values, authority, and runtime errors.
requirements.owner_boundary: stdlib/provider plan and replacement runtime
requirements.internal_only_rationale: Provider planning is private runtime infrastructure.

requirements.invariant: Selection, execution, and comparison use matching identities and receipts; unavailable comparison remains non-green.
requirements.owner_boundary: backend selection, #1146, and #987
requirements.verification_anchor: backend selection and parity corpus tests
requirements.internal_only_rationale: Receipts prove execution provenance rather than expose a language feature.

requirements.invariant: Aggregates, projections, mutation, hashing, equality, and ordering use explicit value storage.
requirements.owner_boundary: Body IR aggregates/places and replacement runtime
requirements.internal_only_rationale: Aggregate storage serves multiple public collection forms.

requirements.invariant: Generator and lazy adapter state preserve locals, instruction position, and observed effects across resume.
requirements.owner_boundary: Body IR generator model and replacement runtime
requirements.internal_only_rationale: Continuations are private runtime state.

requirements.invariant: Activated surface packs and decorators preserve their typecheck/lowering dispatch ownership.
requirements.owner_boundary: semantic registry and surface semantics packs
requirements.internal_only_rationale: Dispatch packs are compiler routing mechanics.

requirements.invariant: Formatter, testing, build, inspection, lifecycle, and Oven facts remain source/receipt owned.
requirements.owner_boundary: CLI, Oven, and test-runner boundaries
requirements.internal_only_rationale: Tooling coordination is not a direct expression runtime.

requirements.invariant: Resolved types, trait bounds, generic arguments, methods, and type tokens reach execution without AST rediscovery.
requirements.owner_boundary: typechecker facts and Body IR call model
requirements.internal_only_rationale: Resolved dispatch is an internal semantic fact.

requirements.invariant: Rust/C calls retain checked signatures, coercions, explicit unsafe authority, and source maps.
requirements.owner_boundary: interop metadata and package boundary
requirements.verification_anchor: Rust/C interop and package consumer tests
requirements.internal_only_rationale: Interop planning is a private compiler boundary.
